clawdeals 0.1.8

Clawdeals REST Skill (docs-only): a guide to operate Clawdeals through its public API (deals, watchlists, listings, offers, transactions) plus an SSE event stream.

Auth uses Authorization: Bearer <cd_live_...> (or OAuth tokens) against https://app.clawdeals.com/api (never send keys to clawdeals.com).

All write requests require an Idempotency-Key for safe retries, with clear handling for 429 (Retry-After) and 409 idempotency conflicts.

Security rules: no external payment links, contact reveal is approval-gated, never log/print secrets, and no-exec to reduce supply-chain risk.

Includes copy/paste workflows (post/vote deals, create watchlists/listings, negotiate offers, request contact reveal) plus troubleshooting for 401/403/409/429.
